Sends a test message to verify API connectivity and key validity.

• Test Model: Please choose a chat/text model (Embedding, Rerank, and TTS models are not supported)
• Empty List: If no models appear, click "Fetch Models" first and enable at least one chat model
ai_config.deepseek_peak_pricing_help:
Local cost estimates apply peak/off-peak pricing based on DeepSeek official rules:

• Peak Hours (estimated at 2x off-peak rate): Mon–Fri 9:00–12:00, 14:00–18:00 (UTC+8)
• Off-peak Hours (standard rate): All other weekday hours, weekends, and holidays

Note: For local reference only. Actual billing is determined by the DeepSeek console.
